agriculture.office: Block Agriculture Office or Tehsil/Lekhpal office
agriculture.ask: crop loss verification, land-record correction, or farmer registration status

ration.office: Food and Civil Supplies Office, ration dealer, or CSC
ration.ask: ration card correction, member addition, e-KYC, or rejected ration application reason

education.office: District Education Office, school/college office, or CSC
education.ask: scholarship application status, institute verification, or missing document reason

pension.office: Social Welfare Office, Block Development Office, or CSC
pension.ask: pension application status, eligibility verification, or bank/Aadhaar seeding issue

housing.office: Gram Panchayat, Block Development Office, or housing department desk
housing.ask: housing/toilet list status, survey correction, or beneficiary verification

health.office: District hospital help desk, Ayushman Mitra, or CSC
health.ask: health card eligibility, hospital claim status, or family ID correction

documents.office: CSC, Tehsil office, or the department desk named on the application
documents.ask: document correction, certificate status, or exact missing document reason

debt.office: Bank branch, District Industries Centre, or CSC
debt.ask: loan application status, subsidy status, or rejection reason in writing

employment.office: Block Development Office, job card desk, District Employment Office, or CSC
employment.ask: job card, work demand, payment delay, or skill-training registration status

default.office: CSC, Block Development Office, or the department office named on the scheme
default.ask: application status, rejection reason, and the exact next document or correction required
